text: The first page of a regular individual passport (valid until at least December 2025) and the visa page for China (if any)High school diploma or pre-graduation certificate (in Chinese or English)High school transcript (in Chinese or English)HSK test scores (only for programs taught in Chinese)Proof of personal financial capacity or financial guarantee (5,000 US dollars or more)Proof of English proficiency such as TOEFL or IELTS (only for English-taught programs)Applicants who are already in China and have studied there are required to provide a statement of their academic performance issued by their previous institutionsA physical examination report within 6 months (the original must be submitted at the time of registration and reporting for admission)
